donate_intro_success_mediatek:
Nanu {softi weer}ku {ceelol} daffesneh.

Nagaale! Anu Rayan, MidiyaTek kibneh derret yan dadlise. Anu qibnaytiino kee kobxissoh awqentitte giibik iroh reebisa ta kibne currik tanim kee fakut tan. Koo catte koo tekkek, ku maganak qokol abtam cubbit hayta — kulli numuh cugayso manol dacrissa.
donate_intro_general_mediatek: Hayyeeh! Anu Rayan, MidiyaTek kibneh derret yan dadlise. Anu mekla qibnaytiino, silac kee kobxisso inni giibik irol ta kibne currik dacrisuh. Alsi addat 200 dollarih gaba bahta — faxe qokol atu abtaah, ciggilta maqnisso akah takkennah abta.
donate_intro_success:
Nanu {softi weer}ku {ceelol} daffesneh.

Nagaale! Anu Rayan, CE, Ayyunti Sostiweer Archive, kee Themes Gallery, wagsiisak derret yan dadlise. Anu nek ~$200 alsih addat ayfaafay kee kobxissoh awqentitte giibik irol kullim currik tan kee fakut tan. Tama aalat koo catek, ku maganak qokol abtam faxximta — tama gadda kulli numuh manol dacrisa.
donate_intro_general: Hayyeeh! Anu Rayan, CE, Ayyunti Sostiweer Archive, kee Themes Gallery, wagsiisak derret yan dadlise. Anu ayfaf qibnaytiino, firmware archive kobxisso, kee domain asqassaabe inni giibik irol kullim currik dacrisuh mekla. Alsi addat 200 dollarih gaba bahta — faxe qokol atu abtaah, tama aalat ciggiila le numuh manoh akah takkennah cato abta.

support_story_1_headline: Murtusa mari gexa wak, ayyunti maaqatta fayya iyya.
support_story_1_lead: isi yahaaz kalalaanam tibba le harxiweer ofloola kee yiddigille sekkacsittek.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis sissin waktitteh addat qusba firmware Y1 (6.0, 7.0, kee 8.0 celta board revisionitte) celtah tan digir abah yan marah sissin qaynatih firmware bicsaanam xiqan. Umam, ken websaayiti foyyah maabitina kee foyya geysiisam dumah taamitak sugeh yan firmware bricked state fanah gactuh. Updater CE kee Ayyunti Firmware porojekti sissin qaynatih addat geytimta: nanu kulli legacy stock ROM archive abnaah, hardware sissin qaynatih addat geytimta, kee sissin qaynatih addat geytimta.
support_story_1_item_1: Tiddigille digir aba cataanam: amaan le cubbusso qusba asqassaabe raagte harxiweer qigdu matakka.
support_story_1_item_2: Archive ROMs: asli kuurih sostiweeritteh kobox kibbiimeh Innioasis duugumteh.
support_story_1_item_3: Baaxoh addah tabi pilaatformi: dudda le urra le silaacitte macOS, laynaksii kee windows inkibisle.
support_story_1_item_4: Harxiweer ixxiga: sisdikuk luucuh baxsi tonnal atu umman way gitat tan package geytam.
support_story_2_headline: googil kokkobiseenit tiddigillem mali. Aleey fayramoh taama. hununuh taamitah yan sostiweer.
support_story_2_lead: Kaxxa sissikaane leeh, diggowteh tan ayyuntiinô daddos atu elle rakittam duddah.
support_story_2_body: Innioasis softiweerik official lowsis abaanam, mango uddur Google Drive linkitte, rabe Baidu cloud shares, kee mistirih zip faylitte lowsis gubat haanam, lowsis gubat haanam kinni. Nanu xisnem numma, currik tan obsih retteemah diggoysiyyi SHA-256 numma, maysaxxagoogi asqassaabe, kee maaqatta-caddoh miraacissa kibne. Ku qokol saanih obsiyyi kee qibnaytiino dacrisaah, tamah ayrol 24 saaqat, sanatal 365 ayro.
support_story_2_item_1: Saanih fayyale sissika CDN: sissikaane, saanih obsiyyi waado sinnim hinnay rabe yasgaarawi.

support_story_3_headline: ku Innioasis digirih dudda inkih fake.
support_story_3_lead: Rook sandug baahaanam, maqmilwah sahlin qilsa le taamah maknayittee kee ankacsi amobaxxaaqa.
support_story_3_body: riig kuurih softi weer dubuk kok Y1 akkek Y2 harxiweer abam duudam. Ni ayyunti Rockbox, sahlin qilsa le maqmiil taamah maknayitte, audiophile codec digir, kee maqmiil ximmooma manol baahe. nanu xaamnam angoyyi harxiweer sissinaane giibik iroh gibbatuh, wadirih mahandis kee umman kibne diggosnuh. Qokol asqassaabe CE saanih too aqayyaareh exxaaxih qokol kee sissikaane le sostiweer dadal.
support_story_3_item_1: Inki-xukko Rook sandug: Xongolo digir qagitak kee maqmiil ximmooma sekenxitteh addat kibbimte.
support_story_3_item_2: Ayyunti Sostiweer: Baatarih maysaasaay, saytun UI kee qasri xongoloh koox qokolu.
support_story_3_item_3: Abinah Harxiweer Lab: Nanu nummah angoyyih yahaadal gibbatna faxe xisne cabaanamak naharal.
support_story_3_item_4: Foyya Biloatweer: %100 currik tan, cankâ- naharsi softi weer maysaxxagoogi akkek kattat sinnim.
support_story_4_headline: Innioasis abe waam abnuh nee cat.
support_story_4_lead: Ayyunti caylale sostiweer dacayri ku yahaadal guddaafah aracak iroh dacrisa.
support_story_4_body: Harxiweer kampaani ciggiila gadget fan gexxa wak, raagte modelitte cabaanah. Innioasis Linux qokol mali, qaddoysiyyi milaagih culma mali, kee kibne radde wak elle geytoonuh sahlin gita mali. uqusbus CE yanih kah kinnim fayxi xoqoysima iroh qidaanam mafaxximta nummaak meqe gad digre. 100% ayyunti doori saanih ta silac kulli numuh fakut haanam fan gexa.
support_story_4_item_1: Cato kee xaaa fidga: jahaazitte ugsaanam cine wayta way diggooweh yan angadaaday cayxi.
support_story_4_item_2: laynaksi naharsi footima qokol: inki gabuuk qokkolsimeh meexiyatek laynaksi distros urra.
support_story_4_item_3: Qado milaagih kutbe: addatino le cabtih kassiisentitte tonnal atu hununuh taaxigeh manni milaagitte.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Ayyunti Qokol: Kulli Buni Kutbeh buxa fakut yanim kee kulli numuh currik yan.
